legend.jma.empty: No data right now (not yet written upstream, or nothing issued at the moment)
legend.jma.snowGaugeOnly: Snow mode draws only stations with a snow gauge.
legend.jma.amedasNote: Updated every 10 minutes; times are Japan time.
legend.jma.attribution: Source: Japan Meteorological Agency (Public Data License 1.0)
legend.jma.warningsNote: Only areas with an active issuance are drawn, taking the highest level for each area; designated cities split into zones (e.g. northern / southern Yokohama) are colored as a whole. Boundaries: Japanese municipal boundaries. Updated every 5 minutes.
legend.jma.quakesNote: A larger circle means a larger magnitude; only the latest report is shown for each earthquake. Updated every 2 minutes.
legend.jma.imageryUncovered: Not covered (missing or no data at this time; not zero)
legend.jma.imageryReason.encoding: image encoding does not match the palette
legend.jma.snowDepthNote: One frame per hour, plays with the timeline; about 5 km grid. Colors follow the official legend; the first two classes are verified against real tiles.
legend.jma.imageryOffHours: No data at night (issued hourly 06–18 JST only)
legend.jma.imageryOffSeason: Off season (sea ice is issued December–May only)
legend.jma.radarNote: One frame every 5 minutes, plays with the timeline; ~1 km grid shown at ~2 km (maximum). Colors follow the official legend (verified against real tiles).
legend.jma.rasrfNote: Radar–rain-gauge analyzed precipitation for the past hour, one frame every 30 minutes. Colors follow the official legend (verified against real tiles).
legend.jma.riskNote: Risk level equivalent to the alert level, one frame every 30 minutes; the lowest class is left uncolored. Colors follow the official legend; not yet verified against colored tiles.
legend.jma.uvNote: Analyzed UV index on a ~0.25° grid, one frame per hour 06–18 JST. Colors follow the official legend (verified against real tiles).
legend.jma.sstNote: Satellite-analyzed daily sea surface temperature (0.1° grid), one frame per day; color ramp taken from the JMA daily SST chart. Land is transparent.
legend.jma.seaIceNote: Sea ice concentration (tenths) in the Sea of Okhotsk, one frame per day, December–May only; open water and land are transparent. Provisional colors (official legend is offline off-season).
legend.jma.himawariNote: Himawari-9 band 13 infrared, one frame per hour; whiter = colder cloud tops, warm clear areas transparent. Grayscale only, not a temperature scale.
